name: PPJACK
recent: PPJACK 在 2026 年 11 月 23 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，并宣布第三次中期股息每股 0.5 仙。公司随后于 11 月 24 日发布股息除权与派发时间表。10 月份有多名董事及大股东申报在公开市场买卖股份及持股变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期单层股息每股 0.5 仙，除权日为 2027 年 1 月 18 日，派发日为 2027 年 1 月 29 日。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
执行董事 Law Book Ching 与 Lim Boon Hua 于 2026 年 10 月 19 日间接增持公司股份。
risks: 多名董事及大股东在 2026 年 10 月申报持股变动及买卖股份。
两名执行董事在 2026 年 10 月 26 日申报在闭市期内有买卖股份的意向。

recent_en: PPJACK announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 23 November 2026 and declared a third interim dividend of 0.5 sen per share. The company subsequently issued the dividend entitlement and payment timetable on 24 November. In October, several directors and substantial shareholders reported share dealings and changes in their holdings.
notable_en: Declared a third interim single-tier dividend of 0.5 sen per share, with ex-date on 18 January 2027 and payment date on 29 January 2027.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
Executive Directors Law Book Ching and Lim Boon Hua acquired indirect interests in the company's shares on 19 October 2026.
risks_en: Several directors and substantial shareholders reported changes in their shareholdings and share dealings in October 2026.
Two Executive Directors notified their intention to deal in shares during the closed period on 26 October 2026.
